binary_representation.description: How binary data is represented in the database. Possible values: 'Base64' (default), 'Uuid'.

connection_type.description: Possible values:`Directly`, `PrivateLink`, `SshTunnel`. `SshTunnel` is used as a value if this parameter is omitted in the request and any of the following parameter's values is specified: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, `tunnel_user`. Otherwise, `Directly` is used as a value if the parameter is omitted.

hosts.description: A list of host addresses of the primary node and all replicas. Each list item is either: a DB instance host/IP address with a port number, or SRV host record.

packed_mode_tables.description: List of tables to be synced in packed mode; format:`<db>.<table>`(case-sensitive).

packing_mode.description: Whether to sync all tables in unpacked mode only, all tables in packed mode only, or specific tables in packed mode. Default value: `UseUnpackedModeOnly`.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.
